observable_admission_and_use: DECam; 16<=r<18; 0.8<=(g-r)0<1.4; frozen primary and W1 availability state 2 or 4; median d<2 kpc. Use for nearby red-star distance comparisons and selected-sample counts.
reference: Gaia geometric; 728004 scored in the legacy held-out reference table
main_limit: Reference-center 68% coverage 61.15% for original PDFs. Counts inherit the magnitude and sky selection.

observable_admission_and_use: Native BASS/MzLS or low-extinction DECam windows; strict grz; 18<=r<20; 2–5 kpc by external distance in the paired benchmark; use as aggregate distance validation.
reference: SpecDis and SPDist; weak or unavailable Gaia geometry
main_limit: The external ordinary-dwarf label is a validation stratum. Unlabelled science targets have mixed composition.

observable_admission_and_use: Native north/high latitude and south/low-latitude windows; E(B-V)<0.03; r<20; strict grz; frozen dwarf score >=0.8 and QRF mass 2–10 kpc >=0.5; median d=2–5 kpc.
reference: Gaia geometry, SpecDis and SPDist with separate denominators
main_limit: Report angular mask, selection and PDF-weighted counts. Unconditional giant contamination and halo completeness are unmeasured.

observable_admission_and_use: Same dwarf-enhanced observable cuts; median d=5–10 kpc.
reference: Gaia and spectra on the available reference subset; independently anchored old cluster sequences
main_limit: Age, evolutionary phase and chemistry alter the luminosity relation and selection. Treat as a research sample.

observable_admission_and_use: South high latitude and north; E(B-V)<0.03, survey-specific strict grz and QRF support; 20<=r<22. Check local imaging depth.
reference: Archived nine-field signed Gaia tests are a separate environmental sample; old sequences provide population-conditional absolute-scale tests
distance_label: signed parallax, with absolute scale from independent clusters
main_limit: Signed samples test population shifts at 0.3–0.5 mag where powered. Individual field-star absolute distances at the faint end remain uncalibrated.

observable_admission_and_use: South and north; 22<=r<23; use per-band errors, geometry and model support flags.
reference: No clean weak Gaia cases in the nine-field census in this magnitude range; available on-sky optical depth matters
main_limit: PDF availability is coverage of inference; no extension of bright-star precision to these objects.

observable_admission_and_use: Development and transfer apertures in the DECam environment study; existing Gaia comparison is predominantly bright; finite-distance map must be reliable and iteration must converge.
reference: Same-source Gaia geometry; replicated in L224 after L233 and L240
distance_label: largely reference 0–2 kpc; see reference table for 2–5
main_limit: L032 deteriorates and mid-latitude responses differ. Sky-wide use requires new environmental coverage.

observable_admission_and_use: High SFD reddening or missing/unreliable Bayestar map; restricted environmental apertures and display footprint.
reference: L219 same-source Gaia geometry; H240 lacks common Bayestar coverage
main_limit: L219 has poor convergence and sign reversal. The high-extinction RGB map is a CMD response.

observable_admission_and_use: Available DR11 imaging with independent native gr coverage and CMD templates; retain map masks and display-specific source counts.
reference: CMD response and gr random area
main_limit: Density and colors are tied to CMD selection. They do not estimate a calibrated stellar spatial density.
